items.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Jon Faddis, Claudio Roditi. Roy Hargrove. Every night a different trumpet player. And that album came out and it was called “To Dizzy With Love.”

ctx.x: He played the piano too, didn’t he?

Yes he did. He had such a knowledge of the piano. You know he had a knowledge of chords that piano players didn’t have. I mean great, wonderful chords too. And so as I said it was a complete learning process for me. It was just so great. And the last gig he played in New York I was on it. He did a whole month at the Blue Note celebrating his 75th birthday, which he did all year, you know every place he went. But he was the only one, it was unprecedented that anyone would work a month in the Blue Note. But each…
